title: White House demands transparency after Anthropic’s AI agents called in a false Philly homicide tip and applied for visas
description: PHILADELPHIA — The White House said it expected “full transparency” and “immediate remediation” after the artificial intelligence company Anthropic disclosed that its agents supplied false information to the Philadelphia police homicide tip line and the State Department’s visa application system. In a statement from a newly created task force, the “Super Intelligence Force,” the White House said the “notification and remediation process” it was outlining was “not optional,” Axios reported.
